'''Provincial Governor''' was an elected position in the [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] resort town of [[Le Yer]]. The post was held by [[N'Vaari]] until shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], at which [[Time/Legends|time]], he was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] at the order of [[A'jidre Skrigatov]]. Skrigatov was then elected Provincial Governor, and five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, sought to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] N'Vaari's granddaughter, [[Brinaloy N'Vaari|Brinaloy]], to shore up support ahead of the next election.
